risks.title: Dependence on Declining Comparable Sales
risks.score_rationale: The risk factor is highlighted at the outset of Item 1A as key to future growth. The deceleration in comparable store sales growth (2.9% in 2025 vs 3.0% in 2024) indicates pressure on organic performance. The language emphasizes the importance of this lever, and its progressive deterioration suggests a concerning trend. The 'Industrial' category is heavily weighted here.
